messages:
Sam T.: Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need clear ownership on GPU capacity & autoscale remediations. I summarized items below.
Dana M.: I'll take scheduler changes + canary. Plan: reduce eviction aggressiveness, bump pod_priority for realtime workloads, and set min_pool_headroom.
Ravi P.: I'll own quota enforcement and traffic shaping rules. Thinking soft throttle at 80% and full circuit-breaker at 93%.
Lena H.: I'll own runbook + alerting. Will add a short playbook for surge triage and paging playbook for oncall.
Sam T.: Action list (owners & rough ETA):
- Scheduler tuning (Dana) 1, test in staging with replay; canary deploy to prod on Tue next week.
- Quota + CB (Ravi) 1, RFC + staged rollout by next Thu.
- Surge runbook (Lena) 1, draft in 48h, final in 5 days.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2024-9101 created followups ticket REM-8120. Linked artifacts: https://drive.redwood.ai/postmortems/INC-2024-9101 and https://tracker.redwood.ai/REM-8120
Dana M.: Scheduler details: change eviction_grace_period from 30s -> 90s, set min_pool_headroom_percent=10, and add a small prioritization tweak: `PriorityClass: real-time=1000, batch=100`. Canary steps: 1) staging replay 2) prod canary on 1 pool 3) monitor 24h.
Ravi P.: Quota design notes: cluster_soft_threshold = 0.8, soft_action = lower-priority routing + alert; hard_threshold = 0.93, hard_action = reject or queue non-critical jobs. Circuit-breaker rule: requests with header X-Priority: low -> route to model-compact or queue. Will open GH issue: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/823
Lena H.: Runbook outline: Detection (dashboard spike > 5% over baseline for 3m), Triage (identify pool and workload), Apply mitigation (reserve temporary nodes, flip circuit-breaker, scale down batch jobs), Escalate (page infra@redwood with REM-8120 link). I'll include exact commands.
Sam T.: Useful commands I use in incidents: 
```
# per-pool utilization
orchctl capacity show --cluster prod --pools all --format csv
# list GPU nodes and alloc
kubectl get nodes -l accelerator=nvidia-gpu -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name} {.status.allocatable.gpu}\n'
# forecast
orchctl forecast --cluster prod --lookback 14d --output table
```
Dana M.: Also proposing a nightly chaos check: 5m synthetic spike against staging autoscaler + post-check alerts. I'll add a CI job under ci/ops/auto-checks.
Ravi P.: On temp borrowing: if gpu-burst empties, allow borrowing from gpu-large with a lease TTL of 30m and automated reclamation. Adding to RFC.
Lena H.: Scheduling a 30-min sync for next Mon to review PRs and runbook. Invite sent to infra, eng-oncall, and product ops.
Sam T.: Recap: Dana = scheduler & nightly test; Ravi = quota/circuit-breaker + borrowing RFC; Lena = runbook & alerts. Please update REM-8120 subtasks when you start. Ping here when PRs/links ready. :white_check_mark:
